Editorial DesignWinter 2025

Scoop Strong

High-protein ice cream book and guide to the Ninja Creami appliance.

✳

The Concept

Scoop Strong is a custom recipe book I wrote and designed to help those on a fitness journey enjoy a sweet treat while also hitting their protein goals. The book helps users learn how to use the Ninja Creami while making high-protein ice cream recipes that support fitness goals. The goal of the project was to create a fun and practical guide that makes it easy to enjoy a treat while still focusing on balanced nutrition.

The Solution

The book introduces the device, explains how it works, and walks readers through simple steps to create different recipes. I wrote the content to be clear and approachable so the recipes feel easy to follow and repeat. The design organizes information into introductory sections and recipe sections, and uses a clean layout that makes instructions easy to read.
